Frieze Seoul 2026のブースでは、Alison Friendの《Tippy Tapper》を展示しております。

作家によるテキストをご紹介します。

'Tippy Tapper' - things that make him go all Tippy Tapper.

The word CHICKEN.

Going into the hallway towards the boots and coats. 

The pop the lid of the biscuit tin makes when you try to open it as quietly as possible.

Telling him he’s a GOOD BOY!
.
.
《Tippy Tapper》2025
